limitations: Correctness is 32x32 sampled output plus full-output finite checks in hashed source; tensors are not saved.
Same inputs, common graph node count and bound closures are source-verified, not reconstructed CUDA graphs.
All runs use the same input seed, device and software; these are separate processes, not independent machine/session samples.
Round bootstrap ignores adjacent-round correlation and multiple comparisons; intervals describe each run only.
Rotated/reversed order balances position in runs 1 and 3; deterministic order does not eliminate clock drift or carry-over.
Run 2 has seven paths across 60 rounds, so positions occur eight or nine times; run 3 is the balanced replication.
